title: Record
description: What tools reported on one subject, one entry per distinct run (format/README.md).

schema.description: The format version the file follows (format/CHANGES.md)

tree.description: A commit of a project, or a file, object or test in it

commit.description: The commit the tool ran on, whole

build.description: The build the command ran in; absent for a tool that reads none, whose record lies under the commit

file.description: The file or object the tool checked, from the top of the tree; absent for a check of the whole tree

test.description: The test as its suite names it, such as generic/001

range.description: The commits the tool checked as patches, BASE..COMMIT, both whole; absent unless it checked them

build.description: The build a command ran in, as the path names it: CONFIGURATION/ARCH/COMPILER

configuration.description: The make target that wrote the .config, or the profiles merged into it, sorted by name; one directory each

series.description: A series by the Message-ID of its first message, before it applies to any commit

entry.description: One run of a command and what it reported; an equal run is added to invocations

tools.description: The tool the command runs first, then those whose version changes what it reports, such as the compiler under sparse

command.description: The command as run at the top of the tree, its paths relative to it, less the variables in env

env.description: The environment variables that change what the command reports, as set when it ran

config.description: sha256: and the SHA-256 of the .config the command ran under; absent when it reads none

status.description: pass: the code passed; fail: the code failed; skip: a test that did not run, its reason as output; error: the tool did not finish for a cause outside the code

exit.description: The command's exit status; for a test, 1 when it failed, else 0

output.description: The errors and warnings the tool printed, verbatim but for the paths format/README.md drops; absent when it printed none

version.description: The version the tool prints of itself; empty for a tool that prints none

build.description: The exact build: its Nix store path, git describe of the source it was built from, a distribution's package and version, or tree for a tool in the tree under test

invocation.description: Who ran the entry's command, when and where

producer.description: The engine that ran the command

origin.description: The lab that ran it, by the name it records under

run.description: The producer's name for the run

started.description: When the command started, in UTC

seconds.description: How long the command ran, in whole seconds

machine.description: The machine the command ran on; never its name

cpus.description: The CPUs the command could use, as nproc counts them

project.description: The project, as the top directory of the Results names it

message_id.description: The Message-ID of a series' first message, without <>: the message posted, or the first of a local mbox
